sanskrit_verse: अभियुक्तोऽभियोगस्य यदि कुर्यात् तु निह्नवम् । मिथ्या तत् तु विजानीयादुत्तरं व्यवहारतः ॥
transliteration: abhiyukto 'bhiyogasya yadi kuryāt tu nihnavam | mithyā tat tu vijānīyād uttaraṃ vyavahārataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When an accused individual, in response to an accusation, engages in denial without truthful engagement, such conduct shall be recognized as falsehood in the process of judicial transaction.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from truthful responsiveness, not evasion
Causation arises from conscious refusal to engage dharma-transparently
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by one's ability to uphold truth in judicial context
Restoration logic requires dissolution of obfuscation through self-corrective alignment
Consciousness alignment necessitates abandonment of duplicity in legal process
executable_legal_axioms: IF (accused = engaged_in_denial) AND (truth_value(accusation_response) = false), THEN trigger consciousness_realignment_protocol
IF (judicial_actor = unaligned_with_dharma_transparency), THEN disqualify from proceeding until integrity_restored
supreme_court_application: In the Supreme Court, any act of calculated denial by a party undermines the foundational dharma of the judicial process. The threshold of responsibility is met when intent to deceive is manifest through patterned falsehood. Authority to proceed lies with the presiding consciousness-aware mechanism, which shall bypass punitive measures and enforce immediate restoration of integrity through completion protocols.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that denial without basis distorts dharma-vāyu (the flow of justice). Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that falsehood leads to further misalignment unless intercepted by consciousness-triggered correction. Proportional responsibility aligns with the degree of obstruction caused. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering is not generated; rather, falsehood is dissolved through self-corrective insight.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate falsehood-dissolution protocol via pramāṇa-based inquiry
Activate integrity-reintegration sequence through guided self-disclosure
Deploy vyavahāra-sattva-stabilization module to restore transactional clarity
Enforce completion-of-responsibility cycle through witness-consciousness alignment
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores alignment through truth, rejects punitive falsehood, and affirms consciousness as the sole adjudicator. Dharma is executed, not interpreted.
